 ALL GOALS: Norway vs. Wales | UEFA Nations League
 Norway secured a 3-1 victory over Wales on a freezing night in Oslo, with Antonio Nusa leading the charge and Erling Haaland sealing the win.
 UEFA Nations League | 🇳🇴 Norway vs Wales 🐉 
 Full Time | Norway Claims an Impressive Victory in Oslo!
 The final whistle blows in Oslo! 🇳🇴 Norway defeats 🐉 Wales 3-1 in a match that started as a tightly contested battle before turning into an impressive attacking display from the Vikings. Antonio Nusa broke the deadlock, Andreas Schjelderup doubled the lead, and Erling Haaland sealed the victory from the penalty spot. David Brooks pulled one back for the Dragons, but it wasn't enough. A convincing Norwegian victory on a freezing night in Oslo!
 🇳🇴 Norway 3-1 Wales 🐉 
 87' | GOOOOOOAL FOR NORWAY! HAALAND MAKES NO MISTAKE FROM THE SPOT!
 The Android makes his mark in Oslo! Erling Haaland steps up to the penalty spot and calmly converts to restore 🇳🇴 Norway's two-goal advantage. The Norwegian superstar delivers when it matters most, leaving 🐉 Wales facing an uphill battle in the closing minutes!
 🇳🇴 Norway 3-1 Wales 🐉 
 78' | GOOOOOOAL FOR WALES! THE DRAGONS PULL ONE BACK IN OSLO!
 Game on in Norway! 🐉 Wales pulls one back through David Brooks , who beats the center-back in a footrace before producing a delightful chipped finish over the onrushing Egil Selvik . A brilliant goal from the Welsh attacker gives the Dragons renewed hope!
 🇳🇴 Norway 2-1 Wales 🐉 
 69' | GOOOOOOAL FOR NORWAY! SCHJELDERUP DOUBLES THE LEAD!
 Norway strikes again in Oslo! 🇳🇴 Norway doubles its advantage through Andreas Schjelderup , who arrives inside the penalty area to tap the ball into the back of the net following an excellent cross from Erling Haaland . The Android turns provider as the Norwegians take a commanding lead against 🐉 Wales !
 🇳🇴 Norway 2-0 Wales 🐉 
 59' | GOOOOOOOAL FOR NORWAY! ANTONIO NUSA BREAKS THE DEADLOCK!
 The breakthrough finally arrives in Oslo! 🇳🇴 Norway is rewarded for its persistence as Antonio Nusa receives the ball on the edge of the penalty area and, without hesitation, unleashes a powerful right-footed strike into the back of the net. What a goal from the Norwegian attacker, sending the home crowd into a frenzy!
 🇳🇴 Norway 1-0 Wales 🐉 
 Three Key Takeaways
 Antonio Nusa delivered the breakthrough with an impressive opening goal.
 Erling Haaland contributed a goal and an assist to secure the victory.
 Norway produced a much stronger second-half performance to claim all three points.
